concern_results.conclusion: `U` and `C` records are frozen only when `is_int(number)` is true. `emit_cached_records` now checks record length, number, `paired_int` and the `loaded_on_step` shape. A test checks results against uncached `shadow_events` after a string `step_index` and again after an append. That would catch replay dropping an unfrozen step.
A string `step_index` can no longer reach `{key}.cache.json`. The `SECRET_*_STEP_INDEX_TOKEN` assertions check the raw cache file, and mutant M23 shows they fail when the guard is removed.
A malformed cached record raises `ValueError`, and the existing code falls back to a full parse. Truncated or extra-length tuples are now rejected before they are unpacked.

The new test builds a 3-block transcript of more than 2 MiB. A seek spy proves the full prefix blocks are reused on append. Same-length edits in blocks 0 and 1 must invalidate the cache. The selector test asserts `npm_required` and the full set of hook suites.
Removing the `HOOK_FILE_MAP` entry brings back the unmapped full hook fan-out. No new flags or abstractions are added.
The cache lives only in the per-user state directory, and a failed validation falls back to a full parse. Reverting carries no migration risk.
Behaviour is unchanged apart from stricter validation. The cache still fails quietly by falling back to a full parse, as before.
The 67/67 test count, the 24/24 mutant count and the M23/M24 rows match the added test and guards. The packet itself does not prove these counts.
Both boundaries are now covered by tests: the between-event privacy rule (no transcript text in the cache) and the full test selection for the Stop gate hook.
The changes follow the `hooks/AGENTS.md` cache privacy rule. The source-register row and the plan text agree with the code, and the contracts are not loosened.
